publisher: Florida Department of Children and Families
ownership: Official Florida DCF child care publication and provider-profile information pages
allowed_use: bounded validation of the official publication link and provider-profile field statement
HEAD-only validation of the exact current workbook URL
immutable retention of privacy-safe metadata evidence
prohibited_use: workbook-body or provider-row acquisition in this version
assuming unpublished status, cadence, schema, contact-field, or reuse semantics
current-operation, statewide-completeness, ZIP-validity, or production claims
attribution: Florida Department of Children and Families
retention: Official page evidence and workbook response headers only; no workbook content.
redistribution: No provider records are acquired or redistributed.
temporal_limits: The workbook response supplies a last-modified timestamp, but DCF does not publish a cadence, snapshot date contract, row status semantics, or historical replay policy on the reviewed pages.
review: A later version must separately authorize and inspect the workbook, pin its sheet/header schema and row controls, identify license/status and provider-type vocabularies, exclude contacts and personal fields, preserve ZIP5 and ZIP4 separately, establish reuse terms, and conserve every row before admission.
